value.rationale: The family answers a natural identifiability question for random BST leaf statistics: for each chosen moment order, many distinctly balanced pivots have identical first r moments, yet no distribution-wide stochastic ranking exists. A single exact rare event reveals the hidden split, with explicit nonasymptotic thresholds and arbitrary r. This structural all-order obstruction is more informative than an isolated moment evaluation.
